text:
maria: quick question — hit an odd edge with the Ruby SDK and streaming + refreshable tokens. looks like stream dies on a mid-stream 401 instead of retrying. anyone seen this?

maria: minimal repro (local):
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(token: "refreshable:aws-oidc://...")
stream = client.chat.completions.stream(model: 'redwood-1', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'hi'}])
stream.each do |chunk|
  puts chunk.text
end
```
behavior: request gets 401 while streaming, token refresh succeeds, but stream raises and doesn't reconnect.

josh: can you paste the exact error/stack? is it HTTPX::StreamError or a 401 encoded in the event?

maria: shorter log: "HTTPX::StreamError: request failed: 401 Unauthorized" then client logs show token refresh ok, but stream handler closed.

sam: seen something like this with older httpx adapter + keepalive. which gem version?

lucy: also if this is 0.6.x vs 0.7.x there was a stream-reconnect tweak.

maria: using 0.6.2 pinned in sampleapp right now.

ops-bot: FYI no infra changes currently that would affect auth in hosted infra.

ci-bot: flake note: ruby-stream-reconnect spec has intermittent 401->recover behavior on GH actions.

josh: short workaround: wrap the stream consumer in a tiny retry loop for now. example: 
```ruby
retries = 0
begin
  client.chat.completions.stream(...).each { |c| handle(c) }
rescue HTTPX::StreamError => e
  retries += 1
  sleep 0.1
  retry if retries < 3
  raise
end
```

sam: we should add an integration test that simulates a mid-stream 401 and asserts reconnect behavior, plus a small PR to the gem to surface a retry hook.

lucy: @sam want to take the PR? i'll review and help with changelog note.

sam: yep, i'll open PR later today with test + small retry wrapper behind a feature flag.

maria: thanks! i'll add a minimal example to `examples/stream-retry` showing the workaround and link it in the quickstart.

josh: also add a note in the SDK parity doc about stream semantics vs go & node so customers know the difference.

maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup: will post PR link when ready.
